title: Beware of auto renewal
body: I did not realize my premium account was active or would be auto renewed when I stopped using the app, which I found not useful. My account was auto renewed annually for 3 years without any notification to me via email or otherwise, and I only realized it when my credit card expired and an email was then sent about the failed renewal. Any.do refused to make any exceptions to give me a refund, citing their policies, without takingy circumstances into account. Beware of their rigid auto renewal policies that rely on your vigilance to ensure you are not charged unnecessarily.

As soon as I saw the charge I asked for a refund and was told the company has no obligation to tell consumers about the renewal and that I should have read the terms and conditions! I wouldn’t deal with any.do again in this basis. “The best way to organise your life” .... really? My experience, to me, proves this app is anything but. And it will cost u money to learn that.

The app take at least 3 seconds to orientate when I change orientation... Reorganizing lists of things is slow... Even checking a thing of the list is slow...

A to-do app is meant to record the user's to-do list quickly and efficiently. What's the use of a to-do app that has lots of extra features but doesn't do its basic functionality...? 

I love this app. And I hope the developers will clean it up a little in the next update and fix all its bugs.

title: Simple n Gd but need improvements
body:
Overall I like the layout and interface of the app. It's neat, clean and simple. Most ideal thing abt To-Do app is simple and easy to use.

However one annoying thing I encounter is there isn't a convenient way to delete any item that I want to delete. Let's say an item is created, I am not able to delete it with a swipe. Have to strike off first then shake to go into the "Done" list and delete it from there. It will definitely be better to include swipe to delete unwanted items. 

Also is it possible to have calendar in portrait mode too? just dividing things into "Today", "Tomorrow", "This Week" and "Later" isn't enough frankly speaking. Maybe a drop down of individual date will make this app more complete! 

Overall good work and hope to see new things soon :)

body:
I have been using Any.do for a couple of months now and I find Any.do fits my needs perfectly. 

Before trying Any.do I was using Clear and Steps (both paid apps) for a time. Both Clear and Steps were highly anticipated and praised apps but I found that Clear was a little too simple for me. Whereas, Steps was better (it snyc with Google Tasks) but somehow the UI didn't really appeal to me. 

And that's where Any.do comes in. It looks great. UI is simple and clean. As the same time it allows me to enter as much text as I want to for each item. It allows me to add notes, set an alarm and it allows me to set my own folders. But best of all, I can install the Any.do on my Chrome browser and add or check off completed tasks straight from my browser. How cool is that?

Try Any.do, it's free. What do you have to lose?

title: Pros & cons
body:
Plus points : Can strikethrough and save tasks. Nothing as satisfying as striking through stuff u have done and this app does that. Many apps dont. You can save tasks too which is amazing for checking back stuff for work - dates meetings were held etc. 

Cons: don't have calendar month view like other apps. I like to be able to have the option to flip through and see what I have in the whole month as well as what I have for today. 2) doesn't have customized reminders. Some apps can do reminders for the "first sat of every month" (when I have my meetings) but this only has for eg " every Saturday"  3) I don't think it can sync to google tasks

title: Recommended
body: I like the simple interface and the calendar feature when tilted sideways. It gives an overview on the activities for the month. What I'll like to have in this app is to be able to place tasks not only in the today, tomorrow and this week section, but also in more sections such as the rest of the days of the week. That way, it saves time for me, rather then to place it in the later section, then tilting the device over showing the calendar interface, then moving the task to the day that I want. Overall, this is a great app and I recommend it to anyone who wants to get organised with your life :)
